page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening). Running head at top with page number above it; main text in one column of justified lines with a brace diagram in the middle; a catchword-like line "Simpli-" at the foot right with signature "R 3" at the foot. Left edge shows fragments of the facing page, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: ones in ecclesia veteri conscriptas à Moșche, vsq; ad funesta Antiochi tempora continet, vt sit veteris testamenti epitome, speculum gratiæ Dei, absolutaq; hominis totius anatome. Luc.24.44.
Psalmi hi primo varijs differentijs ex ipsorum inscriptoribus insigniuntur.

Vna aliqua, vt à forma ode erratica, i. varijs strophis scripta, canticum & Psalmus. Psalm.7. 1.Psal.1.8. ex fine speciali in diem Sabbati, 92. ad testimonium 60. ad dedicationem domus, Psal. 30. ad doctrinam.74.
Propria symphonia, vt magistro symphoniæ. Psal. 4. ad grauem symphoniam. Psal.6.ad gittæa instrumenta. Psal. 8. ad acutam symphoniam. Psal.46. ad πνευματικα instrumenta.53. tempore ad diluculum.22.

p.i: Atque huiusmodi sunt affectiones omnium specierum.
Communes sequuntur vt adumbrari poterunt species.

page.notes: Greek word in "ad πνευματικα" is printed in Greek letters as a tonal word; transcribed as printed, possibly imperfect. The brace diagrams are rendered as lines. Left-margin fragments of the facing page are excluded.
